comparison.objective: Stabilize a leaning panel with a physical stopper and survive a pull test.
comparison.physical_skill: Supporting an unstable load while positioning a passive brace.
comparison.success_condition: Stopper seated, hands withdrawn, panel survives a 0.6 N pull and 2-second stability check within displacement and tilt limits.
comparison.reason: Passive structural bracing differs from adjustment-thread counterholding and retained articulated motion.
